title: Microsoft Defender real-time protection disabled (tampering)
description: MsMpEng.exe (SYSTEM) wrote DisableRealtimeMonitoring=1 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection twice (13:53:18Z, 13:53:38Z); services.exe set WdNisDrv\Start=3 (demand start); the Network Inspection Service stopped; MpCmdRun.exe was spawned by MsMpEng. This is the point where Defender goes OFF, right before atomic run 2 (13:54:52Z). Sysmon itself tagged the events (RuleName 'T1089,Tamper-Defender' / 'T1031,T1050') but Wazuh produced no alert.
